# AI Financial Document Processing API Website

This is a Next.js website for an AI-based financial document processing API that helps accountants scan bank statements, receipts, and invoices to automatically extract data.

## Project Features
- User authentication (sign up/login)
- API documentation and access
- Purple and white themed design
- Responsive layout
- Dashboard for API key management
